title: How to use Visdom to Visualize Ethereum and Blockchain Data
description:
Every 12 seconds, Ethereum produces a new block full of transactions, fees and smart-contract activity. Most people only see this data as a list of hashes on a block explorer. In this hands-on workshop, you will turn it into a live dashboard of your own.

We'll use Visdom and [Web3.py](http://Web3.py) to connect to an Ethereum node and stream blockchain data into charts. By the end of the session, each participant will have a working dashboard that updates with every new block, showing:

- base fee and priority fee over time

- transactions per block

- legacy vs. EIP-1559 transaction types

- the distribution of ETH transferred

- a network overview panel with the latest headline figures

You'll learn how to arrange and save dashboard layouts, and how to set up separate environments for mainnet, testnets or individual contracts. We'll also look at next steps: smart-contract analytics, DeFi and NFT tracking, node health monitoring, and visualizing machine-learning models trained on on-chain data, such as anomaly or bot detection.

No blockchain experience is needed. Basic Python is enough.

**What participants bring:** A laptop with Python 3 installed, and a free Ethereum RPC endpoint from any provider. It would help to share setup instructions in advance so no workshop time goes to installs.
